title: "Proof of use" as a requirement for open source contributions?
summary: An open source maintainer discusses being overwhelmed by AI-generated pull requests that fix unlikely edge cases, and proposes requiring 'proof of use' from contributors—such as showing a dependent project or describing a real production use case—to filter out low-value, drive-by contributions while prioritizing genuine users.
highlights: Maintainer receives many AI slop PRs, most addressing edge cases that rarely occur in real life.
Proposes 'proof of use' requirement: contributors must show a project depending on the maintainer's project before PR review.
Proof can be an existing open source project importing the library (with git history) or a clear description of a closed-source production use case.
Goal is to handle contributions from genuine dependents while filtering out GitHub green-square farming and drive-by LLM noise.
